prompt: A forecast says the probability of rain tomorrow is $0.3$. What is the probability that it does NOT rain tomorrow?
hint: "Rain" and "no rain" are complements: exactly one of them happens, so their probabilities add to $1$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Think in 10 days
steps: Out of 10 days like tomorrow, about 3 would be rainy.
